cues: Imagine a bank that pays one hundred percent interest a year.
Compound it twice a year and you get one point five squared, two point two five.
Yet however often you compound, it never runs away.
It approaches a fixed number: e.
text: Imagine a bank that pays one hundred percent interest a year. Compound it twice a year and you get one point five squared, two point two five. Monthly, more. Daily, more still. Yet however often you compound, it never runs away. It approaches a fixed number: e.
